text: One thing for you: the kit's setting trunk_push is off, so the relaunched parts push their branches but none reaches the kit's main. CL9, CL11 and CL14 say they are done on their branches; each is being checked now (tests run, and red on the old code). May I merge each checked part into the kit's main? A 👍 here means yes, from now on; with no answer they stay on their branches.
